tool.name: Wikitext formatter
tool.description: Format the selection, or the whole source when nothing is selected
dialog.title: Format wikitext
dialog.intro: Review the optional transformations before formatting. Basic safe fixes are always applied.
dialog.indentPipes: Indent block-template pipes by two spaces per nesting level
dialog.alignEquals: Align equals signs in block templates
dialog.sortCategories: Sort consecutive category links by name
dialog.resolveWarning: This can conflict with intentional redirect links and requires API requests.
dialog.highlightMissing: Highlight links to nonexistent pages in red
dialog.highlightWarning: This checks deduplicated links in batched API requests and changes highlighting only.
feedback.noEditor: No MediaWiki source editor was found.
feedback.selection: Wikitext formatting was applied to the selection.
feedback.whole: Wikitext formatting was applied to the whole source.
feedback.failed: Wikitext formatting failed. See the browser console.
